description: Angular component for configuring a mobile app QR code widget, including form setup, validation, and output configuration.

classes.name: MobileAppQrCodeBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent for configuring mobile app QR code widget.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Sets up form controls based on provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data from form values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enableFullscreen property based on selected buttons.
